theorem_title: Exact logarithmic bounds for the entropy supporting line
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.tangent_log_bounds :
    -Real.log (1 - tangentPoint) / Real.log 2 < (272298515211 / 1000000000000 : ℝ) ∧
    (-Real.log (1 - tangentPoint) - Real.log tangentPoint) / (2 * Real.log 2) <
      (140590616299 / 100000000000 : ℝ)  := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For the exact rational tangent point u=0.17200068185091493, the two real quantities -log(1-u)/log(2) and [-log(1-u)-log(u)]/[2 log(2)] are strictly below 0.272298515211 and 1.40590616299 respectively. These are the values at 0 and 1/2 of the binary-entropy tangent line, with all logarithms natural.
